GwenMobile connects to an AI server on your local network (for example Ollama on your Mac) when you add it as an OpenAI-compatible provider.
GwenMobile needs calendar access so it can create, change and delete appointments for you.
GwenMobile needs reminders access so it can create, change and tick off reminders, shopping lists and tasks for you.
GwenMobile needs alarm access so it can start the iPhone's own timer for you, which then rings and lights up when the time is up.
GwenMobile reads your contacts on the device so it can call the person you name.
GwenMobile plays the songs, artists, albums and playlists you ask for from your music library and Apple Music.
GwenMobile uses the camera so you can send photos to the vision model.
GwenMobile needs your location so it can show you nearby shops, pharmacies and addresses and open a route to them.
GwenMobile records your speech so the iOS speech recognition can turn your dictation into text.
GwenMobile uses the iOS speech recognition to transcribe your dictation right on the device.
GwenMobile saves generated pictures to your Photos app.
